text:
ana: Heads-up — noticed weird chart pauses on canary when we have multiple tenants open. Interaction stalls ~300-800ms intermittently. Root cause looks related to telemetry traffic + a recent client build. :frowning:
ben: got the same alerts. Flamegraph: main thread blocked in `telemetry.decodeEnvelope` then `computeLayout`. Link: https://perf.redwood/fg/1716001111
paris: digging — two recent changes line up: 1) routing prefactor `prefetch.fanout=tenant` (routes prefetches to tenant-specific routes) and 2) client switched telemetry encoding to base64+lz4 to support binary spans (client v1.9.0).
rachel: hmm base64+lz4 should reduce bytes, any idea why decode cost is higher?
ana: quick note — client build also merged `span-normalizer` into main chunk to reduce worker churn. That means expensive normalize/merge work runs on main now.
ben: so we have more envelopes (fanout), heavier decode work (lz4 inflate + base64 decode), and a CPU-heavy normalizer on main. Combo = jank.
paris: config excerpt: 
```
# deploy 2026-03-22
prefetch:
  fanout: tenant
telemetry:
  encoding: base64_lz4
bundle:
  splitpoints:
    span_normalizer: merged_into_main
```
router-bot: "canary deploy detected: prefetch.fanout=tenant, telemetry.encoding=base64_lz4, splitpoint span_normalizer merged"
rachel: immediate mitigation ideas: - toggle prefetch.fanout back to `global` in canary - enable `telemetry.defer_decode=true` so decode happens async - flip span_normalizer back to worker lazy-load
ben: I can flip prefetch.fanout now. router-bot: "prefetch.fanout set to global in eu-canary at 1716001135"
paris: I pushed a feature flag `telemetry.defer_decode` and enabled it in canary. router-bot: "feature toggle telemetry.defer_decode=true for eu-canary at 1716001140"
ana: quick local repro with flags on shows stalls drop to ~50-120ms. Good temporary win.
ben: longer-term: 1) move span_normalizer into worker-shared chunk 2) add parse/normalize perf gate in CI (fail if main-thread decode+normalize > 100ms) 3) dedupe prefetches at router by tenant-session to avoid fanout duplicates 4) consider changing telemetry encoding to v2 that streams framed messages to worker via postMessage instead of base64.
paris: opened ENG-PLAT-900 (worker-shared span_normalizer), ENG-PLAT-901 (prefetch dedupe), ENG-PLAT-902 (telemetry-encoding-v2), ENG-PLAT-903 (perf-gate decode time).
ci-bot: "CI perf job added: telemetry-decode-bench will run on PRs and report median decode+normalize time"
rachel: rollout UX idea: add a canary guard that watches `main_thread.telemetry_decode_ms` > 150ms sustained and auto-pauses telemetry sampling or reverts prefetch.fanout. That would prevent broad regressions.
ana: agreed — also instrument `telemetry.envelopes_per_interaction` and `prefetch.duplicate_rate` in console so we can correlate.
ben: I'll keep prefetch.fanout global on canary for 24h and monitor. Leaving telemetry.defer_decode=true until worker split lands.
ana: thanks team — good triage. We'll coordinate tickets and follow up in ENG-PLAT sync. :rocket:
